name: Perspective Volume Rendering
definition: Perspective volume rendering includes axial, coronal, and sagittal views, and can support immersive rendering (virtual bronchoscopy) with a point of view within the anatomy.
summary: Perspective Volume Rendering generalizes X-ray transforms to 3D perspective projection by applying distance-based 1/r² weighting to account for off-center ray traversal, distinguishing it from standard orthographic ray casting.
